scope: Four complete supplied essays in eight languages, with targeted editorial and scientific corrections. Original source folder and ZIPs unchanged.

review.method: Read all four Simplified Chinese arguments and check correction sites, selected examples and conclusions across languages. This is targeted scientific/editorial review, not exhaustive independent verification of every assertion.
review.originals: All 32 imported texts were checked byte for byte against the supplied Markdown files / ZIP members and stored SHA-256.
corrections: EP13: active tracheal ventilation and conditional diffusion scaling; distinguish fruit-fly experimental timescales from deep-time dragonfly evolution; incomplete upland sampling is not absence, and sampling artifacts do not disprove every real mechanism.

EP14: most land in Pangaea, not all; GSSP scope; zircon dates crystallization rather than ash landing; avoid universal heat-death thresholds; distinguish the coal gap from absence of forests, complex-reef recovery from absence of small reefs, and coral taxonomy from settled ancestry; Early Triassic pressures outlast the main extinction interval. Correct Simplified Chinese eight-million-year relative date and meeting-room hypercapnia analogy.

EP15: the marine extinction interval is not a global land-collapse stopwatch; fossil specimen proportions are not living population censuses; correct Ediacaran cross-reference; remove modern grassland anachronism; qualify coral ancestry and pyrite-framboid redox inference; avoid universal or final recovery claims.

EP16: bee castes reflect developmental regulation, not identical genomes or absolute worker sterility; oldest amber ants versus oldest ants overall; historical bee identification; correct Diacamma gemmae and mating effects; individual and colony selection can coexist; nonadditivity does not restrict kin selection to post-hoc fitting. Both modeling frameworks require explicit assumptions and testable predictions.
All four essays: retain the episode-specific ending and remove the recurring generic closing refrain.
review.references: Selected research and author-institution sources are linked under each article; see references.json.
review.completeness: All eight sections and original paragraph counts retained. Minimum reviewed/original character ratio exceeds 1.001; this check supports but does not replace reading.

verification.structural: scripts/test_paleontology.py: 4 tests passed; full text, immutable sources, reproducibility, language metadata, publication dates, internal links, taxonomy, discovery and grouping.
verification.regression: EP01–11 byte-identical to pre-batch HEAD; EP12 changes only next-essay navigation. Unrelated search records unchanged. Existing article publication dates and unchanged sitemap lastmods preserved.
verification.discovery: 32 added search source records and 32 new sitemap URLs; 136 series HTML pages, 17 per language.
verification.browser: 408 page/viewport cases passed at 375/768/1440 px, including heading visibility, eight-language menus, TOC anchors and no horizontal overflow. Library/Latest language-aware links and no-JS English-to-Japanese navigation passed; zero page errors. Grouped hub, English EP13 desktop and Traditional Chinese EP16 mobile screenshots visually inspected with no overlap.
